name: Saudi Oil Burn Forecaster
info: Forecasts monthly Saudi Arabia crude oil direct burn for power generation using weather data, machine learning ensemble models, and temperature-based override rules. Integrates real-time weather from 7 major Saudi cities with historical burn patterns to predict oil consumption 1-6 months ahead.

forecast_months.name: Forecast Horizon
forecast_months.tooltip: Number of months ahead to forecast. Model accuracy decreases with longer horizons as weather forecasts become less reliable.

use_weather_forecast.name: Use Weather Predictions
use_weather_forecast.tooltip: Use API weather forecasts for future months. If disabled, uses historical weather averages which may be less accurate but more stable.

confidence_level.name: Confidence Interval
confidence_level.tooltip: Statistical confidence level for prediction bounds. Higher levels give wider but more reliable intervals.

apply_extreme_heat_rules.name: Enable Temperature Overrides
apply_extreme_heat_rules.tooltip: Apply rule-based adjustments when extreme heat conditions (>118°F with high extreme day counts) are detected. Prevents underestimation during heat waves.

cities_weight_override.name: City Weighting Method
cities_weight_override.tooltip: How to weight weather data from the 7 Saudi cities. Population-based uses demographic weighting, equal treats all cities the same.

season_focus.name: Seasonal Optimization
season_focus.tooltip: Optimize model performance for specific seasons. Summer uses dedicated summer model with enhanced heat sensitivity.
